label: Barari et al. four-module conversational survey experiment
design: three-arm randomized web-survey experiment with four embedded question modules
population: U.S. adults recruited from a proprietary non-probability panel and quota-sampled on age, gender, and education
setting: Inca web conversational survey, fielded July 15-17, 2024
intervention: LLM-generated confirmation probes or elaboration/relevance probes, with live zero-shot coding
methods: participant-level random assignment to three conditions
four question-level experiments on national issues, economic conditions, news sources, and occupation
OLS estimates with and without covariates and BHq-adjusted confidence intervals
blind human coding of response-quality criteria
measures: specificity, explanation, relevance, completeness, comprehensibility, and concision
word count, lexical diversity, Shannon entropy, and KL divergence
attrition, duration, ease, frustration, satisfaction, and perceived quality
